name: Nezumi
traits: Ratlike humanoid with a long muzzle, prominent incisors, rough fur, and a mostly bare tail. The printed setting describes Nezumi in Rokugan and the Shadowlands.
Medium. Base land speed 40 ft. Constitution +2, Charisma −2.
Low-light vision extends useful vision to twice the human distance in dim conditions while retaining color and detail.
Racial +2 to Hide and Move Silently. Racial +2 on saves against poison and disease.
Immune to acquiring a Shadowlands Taint score and to ill effects of direct Shadowlands exposure. Taint spells and Shadowlands creature attacks can still harm a Nezumi.
Claw or bite deals 1d4 normal damage as an unarmed strike. Choose one of these unarmed attacks per round.
Keen Scent permits the optional Scent feat at Wisdom 11 or higher. It does not grant that feat automatically.

With Scent, detect a presence as a free action within 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double these ranges and overpowering odors triple them. Finding direction costs a move-equivalent action. Pinpoint within 5 ft.

With Scent, follow a trail using Wisdom. A fresh trail is usually DC 10 and the DC rises by 2 per hour. Scent and group size can modify it. Surface and visibility penalties do not apply. Water can erase a trail, and masking odors raise the base tracking DC to 20. The track otherwise follows the Track feat.
Automatic languages Rokugani and Nezumi. Bonus languages Bakemono and Shadowlands. Favored class Rogue.

name: Vanara
traits: Monkeylike humanoid with rounded ears, furred cheeks, long fingers and toes, and a semi-prehensile tail. The printed setting places Vanaras in deep forests and high mountains outside Rokugan.
Medium. Base land speed 30 ft. Climb speed 20 ft. Strength −2, Intelligence +2, Wisdom +2.
Racial +8 to Climb. Use the better of Strength or Dexterity for Climb checks, and take 10 even when rushed or threatened.
An accelerated climb covers 30 ft. with one Climb check at −5 each round.
Low-light vision extends useful vision to twice the human distance in dim conditions while retaining color and detail.
Racial +4 to Balance and Jump. Racial +2 to Hide and Move Silently.
Automatic languages Common and Vanara, called Vanaran in the prose. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Spirit Tongue, and Sylvan. Favored class Shaman.
